Required action: for a diff touching skills/agents/rules/dispatch prompts, run the context-propagation audit before correctness-review — build the source→consumer matrix (main, implementer, reviewer, scorer, new session) with delivery mode (always-loaded, paths-triggered, pasted, explicit Read) and proof per row.

Key safety gate: fail the audit if any load-bearing instruction is `assumed`/`unconfirmed`, if child-context delivery is inferred only from main-session behavior, or if an inline policy copy is unanchored (no explicit Read/drift test). A no-consumer result counts as unknown, not absent, unless the search surface is named.
